        "contents": "const AIRoleManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst saveRole = async \n\n    try {\n      let result;\n      const isUpdate = selectedRole &amp;&amp; selectedRole.id;\n      \n      if (isUpdate) {\n        // 更新现有角色 - 使用selectedRole.id确保准确性\n        result = await aiRoleService.updateAIRole(selectedRole.id, formData);\n      } else {\n        // 创建新角色\n        result = await aiRoleService.createAIRole(formData as Omit&lt;AIRoleConfig, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'&gt;);\n      }\n\n      if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: result.message || '保存成功' });\n        setIsEditing(false);\n        \n        // 先重新加载角色列表\n        await loadRoles();\n        \n        // 从最新列表中找到保存的角色并选中\n        const savedRoleId = result.data.id;\n        // 使用useEffect监听roles变化来更新selectedRole，或者直接从result.data获取\n        const updatedRole = result.data as AIRoleConfig;\n        setSelectedRole(updatedRole);\n        setFormData(updatedRole);\n        \n        // 如果角色被使用，重新加载使用情况\n        if (savedRoleId) {\n          await loadRoleUsage(savedRoleId);\n        }\n      } else {\n        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: result.error || '保存失败' });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : (error as any)?.response?.data?.message || '未知错误';\n      const errorStatus = (error as any)?.response?.status || 'N/A';\n      console.error('保存角色失败:', {\n        message: errorMessage,\n        status: errorStatus,\n        url: (error as any)?.config?.url || (error as any)?.response?.config?.url,\n        fullError: error\n      });\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '保存角色失败' });\n    } finally {\n      setSaving(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除角色\n  const deleteRole = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\nasync update(id: string, data: UpdateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n\n\n    const params = [\n      data.name ?? existing.name,\n      data.description ?? existing.description,\n      data.avatar !== undefined ? data.avatar : existing.avatar,\n      data.systemPrompt !== undefined ? data.systemPrompt : existing.systemPrompt,\n      JSON.stringify(configToStore),\n      data.enabled !== undefined ? (data.enabled ? 1 : 0) : existing.enabled ? 1 : 0,\n      data.source !== undefined ? data.source : existing.source,\n      id,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as AIRoleConfig;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除AI角色\n   */\n  async delete(id: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新AI角色\n   */\n  async update(id: string, data: UpdateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    // 获取现有角色\n    const existing = await this.getById(id);\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${id}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE ai_roles SET\n        name = ?,\n        description = ?,\n        avatar = ?,\n        system_prompt = ?,\n        dify_config = ?,\n        enabled = ?,\n        source = ?,\n        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n    &#96;;\n\n    // 决定更新的配置\n    let configToStore: any;\n    const provider = data.provider ?? existing.provider ?? 'dify';\n    \n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      if (data.agentConfig) {\n        configToStore = { provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: data.agentConfig };\n      } else if (existing.agentConfig) {\n        configToStore = { provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: existing.agentConfig };\n      } else {\n        // 从 difyConfig 迁移到 agentConfig（如果需要）\n        configToStore = { provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: existing.agentConfig };\n      }\n    } else {\n      if (data.difyConfig) {\n        configToStore = { provider: 'dify', ...data.difyConfig };\n      } else if (existing.difyConfig) {\n        configToStore = { provider: 'dify', ...existing.difyConfig };\n      } else {\n        // 保持现有配置\n        const existingConfig = JSON.parse((existing as any).dify_config || '{}');\n        configToStore = existingConfig;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const params = [\n      data.name ?? existing.name,\n,\n    ];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const AIRoleEditModal: React.FC&lt;AIRoleEditModalProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 表单验证\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =&gt; {\n    const newErrors: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n\n    if (!formData.name?.trim()) {\n      newErrors.name = '角色名称不能为空';\n    }\n\n    if (!formData.description?.trim()) {\n      newErrors.description = '角色描述不能为空';\n    }\n\n    if (formData.provider === 'dify' || !formData.provider) {\n      if (!formData.difyConfig?.apiUrl?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['difyConfig.apiUrl'] = 'API地址不能为空';\n      }\n      if (!formData.difyConfig?.apiKey?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['difyConfig.apiKey'] = 'API密钥不能为空';\n      }\n    } else if (formData.provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      if (!formData.agentConfig?.llm?.apiKey?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['agentConfig.llm.apiKey'] = 'API Key不能为空';\n      }\n      if (!formData.agentConfig?.llm?.model?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['agentConfig.llm.model'] = '模型名称不能为空';\n      }\n      if (!formData.agentConfig?.llm?.apiBaseUrl?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['agentConfig.llm.apiBaseUrl'] = 'API地址不能为空';\n      }\n      if (!formData.agentConfig?.prompt?.systemPrompt?.trim()) {\n        newErrors['agentConfig.prompt.systemPrompt'] = '系统提示词不能为空';\n      }\n    }\n\n    setErrors(newErrors);\n    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;\n  };\n\n  // 更新表单字段\n  const updateFormField = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建AI角色\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    await this.initializeTable();\n\n    const id = data.id || &#96;ai-role-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    const enabled = data.enabled !== undefined ? (data.enabled ? 1 : 0) : 1;\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO ai_roles (\n        id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n        created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n\n    // 根据 provider 决定存储的配置\n    let configToStore: any;\n    if (data.provider === 'direct-agent' &amp;&amp; data.agentConfig) {\n      configToStore = { provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: data.agentConfig };\n    } else {\n      configToStore = { provider: data.provider || 'dify', ...data.difyConfig };\n    }\n\n    const params = [\n      id,\n      data.name,\n      data.description,\n      data.avatar || null,\n      data.systemPrompt || null,\n      JSON.stringify(configToStore),\n      enabled,\n      data.source || null,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as AIRoleConfig;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取AI角色\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 更新AI角色\n * PUT /api/v1/ai-roles/:id\n */\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const existingRole = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\n    \n    if (!existingRole) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'AI角色不存在'));\n    }\n    \n    const { name, description, avatar, systemPrompt, provider, difyConfig, agentConfig, enabled, source } = req.body;\n    \n    const updateData: UpdateAIRoleDTO = {\n      ...(name !== undefined &amp;&amp; { name }),\n      ...(description !== undefined &amp;&amp; { description }),\n      ...(avatar !== undefined &amp;&amp; { avatar }),\n      ...(systemPrompt !== undefined &amp;&amp; { systemPrompt }),\n      ...(provider !== undefined &amp;&amp; { provider }),\n      ...(difyConfig !== undefined &amp;&amp; { difyConfig }),\n      ...(agentConfig !== undefined &amp;&amp; { agentConfig }),\n      ...(enabled !== undefined &amp;&amp; { enabled }),\n      ...(source !== undefined &amp;&amp; { source }),\n    };\n    \n    const updatedRole = await aiRoleModel.update(id, updateData);\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedRole, '更新AI角色成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('更新AI角色失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '更新AI角色失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除AI角色\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-roles/:id\n */\nrouter.delete",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst saveAgentRole = async \n\n\n      const updatedConfig: FieldMappingConfig = {\n        ...existing,\n        featureObjects,\n      };\n\n      await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(editingMappingForAgent.workflowId, updatedConfig);\n      setMessage({ type: 'success', text: 'Agent角色配置成功' });\n      setShowAgentModal(false);\n      setEditingMappingForAgent(null);\n      setSelectedAgentId('');\n      await loadData();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存Agent角色失败:', error);\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '保存Agent角色失败，请稍后重试' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatDate = (dateString: string) =&gt; {\n    const date = new Date(dateString);\n    return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN', {\n      year: 'numeric',\n      month: '2-digit',\n      day: '2-digit',\n      hour: '2-digit',\n      minute: '2-digit',\n    });\n  };\n\n  return\n;",
        "signatures": {

        "contents": "const AIRoleManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 加载角色列表\n  const loadRoles = async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const roleList = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n      // 去重：基于ID去除重复的角色\n      const uniqueRoles = Array.from(\n        new Map(roleList.map(role =&gt; [role.id, role])).values()\n      );\n      setRoles(uniqueRoles);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '未知错误';\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status;\n      \n      const errorCode = error?.code;\n      \n      // 对于404、500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），静默处理，不输出控制台错误\n      // 只在UI上显示友好的提示消息\n      if (errorStatus === 404 || errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\n        // 不输出控制台日志，只显示UI提示\n        setMessage({ \n          type: 'error', \n          text: '后端API未找到，请检查后端服务器是否运行在3003端口'\n        });\n      } else {\n        // 其他错误才输出控制台日志\n        console.error('🔵 [AIRoleManagementPage] 加载AI角色列表失败');\n        console.error('错误消息:', errorMessage);\n        console.error('HTTP状态码:', errorStatus);\n        console.error('请求URL:', error?.config?.url || error?.response?.config?.url);\n        \n        // 区分错误类型，给出更友好的提示\n        let errorText = '';\n        if (errorStatus === 0 || errorStatus === 'ECONNREFUSED') {\n          errorText = '无法连接到后端服务器，请确认后端服务已启动';\n        } else {\n          errorText = &#96;加载AI角色列表失败: ${errorMessage}&#96;;\n        }\n        \n        setMessage({ \n          type: 'error', \n          text: errorText\n        });\n      }\n      \n      // 即使后端失败，也尝试显示localStorage中的配置\n      const configs = migrationService.getLocalStorageConfigs();\n      if (configs.smartWorkflowConfigs.length &gt; 0 || configs.independentPageConfigs.length &gt; 0) {\n        setLocalStorageConfigs(configs);\n      }\n    }\n;\n;",

## 修复总结

已修复角色信息编辑后保存配置无效的问题。主要修改如下：

### 1. **修复 `AIRoleEditModal` 的 `handleSave` 函数**
   - 问题：`formData` 可能不完整，导致保存时丢失字段
   - 修复：确保所有字段正确合并，包括：
     - 使用原有角色字段作为后备
     - 正确合并嵌套对象（`difyConfig` 和 `agentConfig`）
     - 确保所有必需字段存在

### 2. **修复 `handleSaveRole` 函数**
   - 问题：更新时传递了整个对象，包含不应更新的元数据字段
   - 修复：
     - 更新时只传递需要更新的字段，排除 `id`、`createdAt`、`updatedAt`
     - 保存后正确更新 `selectedRole` 和 `formData`
     - 重新加载角色列表和使用情况
     - 如果是新建角色，自动选中它

### 主要改进点：

1. 数据完整性：确保所有编辑的字段都被正确保存
2. 数据同步：保存后自动更新 UI 中的角色信息
3. 错误处理：保持错误处理逻辑

现在，编辑角色信息后点击"保存配置"，所有修改的字段都会被正确保存，并且 UI 会立即反映最新的数据。

        "contents": "const AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&gt; = \nconst handleCreateAndAssignRole = async \n\n\n      // 2. 尝试自动分配给第一个字段映射配置\n      try {\n        const configs = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        if (configs.length &gt; 0) {\n          let updated = false;\n          for (const configItem of configs) {\n            const featureObjects = configItem.config.featureObjects || [];\n            const featureIndex = featureObjects.findIndex((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType === featureType);\n            \n            if (featureIndex &gt;= 0) {\n              // 更新现有的 feature object\n              featureObjects[featureIndex] = {\n                ...featureObjects[featureIndex],\n                agentId: result.role.id\n              };\n              \n              await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(configItem.workflowId, {\n                ...configItem.config,\n                featureObjects\n              });\n              updated = true;\n            }\n          }\n          \n          if (updated) {\n            if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n            loadNodeStatuses(); // 重新加载状态\n          } else {\n             alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建，但在现有字段映射配置中未找到对应功能项。请前往配置页面手动添加。&#96;);\n             if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n          }\n        } else {\n            alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建。由于没有字段映射配置，无法自动分配。&#96;);\n            if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.error('分配角色失败:', e);\n        alert(&#96;角色 \"${result.role.name}\" 已创建，但在自动分配时发生错误。请手动配置。&#96;);\n        if (onRefresh) onRefresh();\n      }\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('操作失败:', error);\n      alert('操作失败，请查看控制台日志');\n    } finally {\n      setCreatingRole(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleOpenSelector = (status: NodeConfigStatus) =&gt;\n;\n;",

## 修复总结

已修复“保存配置”按钮点击无反应的问题。主要修改如下：

### 1. **添加错误提示状态**
   - 新增 `saveError` 状态，用于显示保存失败的原因

### 2. **改进表单验证逻辑**
   - `validateForm` 现在返回验证结果和错误信息
   - 验证失败时自动切换到对应的 section 并滚动到第一个错误字段

### 3. **改进按钮点击事件处理**
   - 添加 `e.preventDefault()` 和 `e.stopPropagation()` 防止事件被阻止
   - 添加 `type="button"` 确保按钮不会触发表单提交

### 4. **添加错误提示 UI**
   - 在底部操作栏上方添加错误提示区域
   - 验证失败或保存失败时显示错误信息

### 5. **改进错误处理**
   - 保存失败时不关闭模态框，让用户看到错误信息
   - 添加调试日志帮助排查问题

### 主要改进点：

1. 用户反馈：验证失败或保存失败时显示明确的错误提示
2. 自动导航：验证失败时自动切换到包含错误的 section
3. 事件处理：确保按钮点击事件不被阻止
4. 错误恢复：保存失败时保持模态框打开，方便用户查看错误并重试

现在点击“保存配置”按钮应该可以正常工作。如果验证失败，会显示错误提示并自动导航到错误字段；如果保存失败，会显示具体的错误信息。

请测试一下，如果还有问题，可以查看浏览器控制台的日志信息。

CRITICAL - Element Identification:
- Use the "selector" field to find the target element (contains CSS selector like "#id", ".class", or tag)
- "elementPath" contains the DOM path (e.g., "html > body > div > ...") - use to understand element hierarchy
- "elementHTML" shows the element's HTML structure for verification
- "elementClasses" lists all CSS classes on the element - search for these in stylesheets
- If "elementReactComponent" is provided, the component name (e.g., "Button", "Card") indicates where to look

CRITICAL - Where to Make Changes:
1. First check if the element uses utility classes (Tailwind, Bootstrap): modify the className/class attribute in JSX/TSX
2. For CSS Modules (*.module.css): find the imported module and update the corresponding class
3. For styled-components/emotion: find the styled() or css`` definition in the component file
4. For global CSS/SCSS: locate the stylesheet imported by the component or in global styles
5. For inline styles: update the style prop directly in the JSX/TSX file

CRITICAL - Making the Actual Change:
- "property" is the CSS property name (e.g., "color", "padding", "font-size")
- "oldValue" is the current value - use this to locate the exact line to change
- "newValue" is what it should be changed to
- Preserve CSS units and format (e.g., if oldValue was "16px", keep pixel units unless converting to rem/em)

For CSS Style Changes:
1. Search for the element using "selector" or "elementClasses" to find relevant stylesheets
2. Find the exact CSS rule containing "property: oldValue"
3. Replace "oldValue" with "newValue"
4. If no existing rule exists, add a new declaration to the appropriate CSS file or inline style
5. For Tailwind: convert the CSS property/value to the appropriate utility class (e.g., "padding: 16px" → "p-4")
6. Ensure specificity is maintained - don't accidentally override other rules

已完成所有修改。总结如下：

## 修改总结

### 1. **文本更新**
   - "独立Agent" → "LLM驱动"
   - "Dify工作流" → "Dify驱动"
   - 更新位置：
     - 角色列表中的类型标签
     - 统计卡片
     - 分组标题
     - 表单选择器
     - AIRoleEditModal 组件

### 2. **图标区分**
   - LLM驱动（direct-agent）：
     - 使用 `Cpu` 图标
     - 紫色渐变背景（`from-purple-500 to-purple-600`）
   - Dify驱动（dify）：
     - 使用 `Workflow` 图标
     - 蓝色渐变背景（`from-blue-500 to-blue-600`）

### 3. **更新的视图**
   - 表格视图：根据 provider 显示不同图标
   - 列表视图：根据 provider 显示不同图标和背景色
   - 所有相关文本已统一更新

现在两种类型的角色在界面上可以通过图标和文本清晰区分：
- LLM驱动：紫色 + Cpu 图标
- Dify驱动：蓝色 + Workflow 图标

所有修改已通过 lint 检查，可以正常使用。

        "contents": "export const createPresetRole = async (featureType: string): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; role?: AIRoleConfig; error?: string }&gt; =&gt; {\n  const config = PRESET_ROLES[featureType];\n  if (!config) {\n    return { success: false, error: '未找到预设配置' };\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // 检查是否已存在同名角色\n    const existingRoles = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n    const existingRole = existingRoles.find(r =&gt; r.name === config.name);\n    \n    if (existingRole) {\n      return { success: true, role: existingRole };\n    }\n\n    // 创建新角色\n    const response = await aiRoleService.createAIRole({\n      ...config,\n      enabled: true,\n      avatar: '🤖' // 默认头像\n    } as any);\n\n    if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        // 转换返回的数据以匹配AIRoleConfig类型\n        const newRole = {\n            ...response.data,\n            createdAt: new Date(response.data.createdAt),\n            updatedAt: new Date(response.data.updatedAt)\n        };\n      return { success: true, role: newRole };\n    } else {\n      return { success: false, error: response.message || response.error || '创建失败' };\n    }\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    return { success: false, error: error.message || '创建过程发生错误' };\n  }\n};",
